faqs.q: What types of partnerships do you offer?
faqs.a: We offer two main models: Event Partnerships, where you co-create workshops and events with our students, and Branding Sponsorships, where your brand gains visibility across our network. Both can be customized to fit your goals.
Partnerships are flexible and can range from a single event to a full semester engagement. We work with you to find the right level of involvement that matches your capacity and goals.

You define the topic and framework in coordination with TechLabs. We handle organization, outreach, and logistics. Your team leads the workshop with tech-enthusiastic students eager to learn from industry experts.

faqs.q: Can we expand our partnership to other locations?
faqs.a: Absolutely! TechLabs operates in 16 locations across 8 European countries. Partnerships can start locally and scale to additional cities based on your reach and objectives.

faqs.q: What kind of students will we work with?
faqs.a: Our participants come from STEM and business backgrounds, with 46% female representation. They are pre-selected, motivated individuals learning Data Science, AI, Web Development, and UX Design.
Simply reach out through our contact form or email us. We'll schedule an introductory call to understand your goals and propose a tailored partnership model.
